title: Hayati Pro Max Plus Blue Razz Blackcurrant Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Blue Razz Blackcurrant blends the sharp, tangy bite of Blue Raspberry-style flavour with the darker, fuller taste of Blackcurrant. The mix lands sweet and juicy with a gentle cool note to keep it bright on the finish. Each Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod is supplied as a prefilled 2ml pod connected to an integrated 10ml refill reservoir, for a total of 12ml of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid. No loose bottles, no refilling and no coil swaps. Just click it into the Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod Kit and vape. With a dual mesh coil and draw-activated inhale, the pod is tuned for discreet MTL vapour and consistent flavour. One pod can deliver up to 6000 puffs (approx.), depending on personal use. Replace with a new pod once taste starts to fade or the reservoir is empty. Discover more flavours with our full selection of Hayati Pro Max Plus Pods .
